name: Hoshimi Hiroko Sweet Girlish Soprano v4
prompt: An original young adult Japanese female voice around age nineteen, speaking native standard Japanese. Very high-pitched, petite, sugary-sweet girlish soprano with bright, sparkling bell-clear forward resonance, light delicate vocal weight, and cute, lovely anime-heroine charm. Fluid, natural human breathing and sweet, smiling melodic inflection that sounds unmistakably young and girlish.
